description: This file defines interfaces and a template class related to stream handling within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It declares an IStream interface with methods for managing stream state and identities, and a StreamType template class that adapts a BASESTREAM class to implement IStream, forwarding method calls.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Core::IStream
classes.description: An interface for stream operations, including opening, closing, and retrieving local and remote identifiers.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Core::StreamType
classes.description: A template class that inherits from a user-provided BASESTREAM class and implements the IStream interface by forwarding calls to the base class.

methods.name: IStream::IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the stream is open.

methods.name: IStream::IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the stream is closed.

methods.name: IStream::LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local identifier of the stream.

methods.name: IStream::RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier of the stream.

methods.name: IStream::Open
methods.description: Opens the stream with a specified wait time.

methods.name: IStream::Close
methods.description: Closes the stream with a specified wait time.

methods.name: IStream::Trigger
methods.description: Triggers some action on the stream.

methods.name: StreamType<BASESTREAM>::StreamType
methods.description: Constructor that forwards arguments to the BASESTREAM constructor.

methods.name: ~StreamType<BASESTREAM>
methods.description: Destructor (default).
